payload.name: Keyword Capture Validated and Hit Driven
payload.description: Keywords are captured deterministically first, expanded by a zero-shot call last, stored only after validation, and ranked by observed hits, not by rarity or word lists.

principles.name: Keywords earn their place
principles.description: A term stays because observed use confirms it, not because it was proposed.

principles.name: Language neutrality belongs to the model
principles.description: Filler handling is done by the judgment and the learned ranker, not by hand-kept word lists.

heuristics.condition: a search returns a flood for a common word
heuristics.action: look for substring matching or flat seed scores before blaming the word list

heuristics.condition: a model is proposed to rank keywords
heuristics.action: require real labelled hit groups and a held-out yes or no evaluation first

decision_rules.name: Capture first, expand last
decision_rules.condition: keywords are created for a container
decision_rules.outcome: capture the deterministic terms first and run the zero-shot expansion last to identify the true keywords, validate hits, and then score

decision_rules.name: Store only validated terms
decision_rules.condition: a keyword is about to be stored
decision_rules.outcome: store it only after the validation gate confirms it with every round's yes; an unvalidated stored keyword is removed or sent back to validation

decision_rules.name: Expansion terms start unvalidated
decision_rules.condition: a term comes from zero-shot expansion
decision_rules.outcome: mark it unvalidated and promote it only through observed hits (kept or applied)

decision_rules.name: Rank by hits, not rarity
decision_rules.outcome: rank by observed hit events (returned, packed, kept, applied) and never by rarity or inverse frequency; keep substring and stoplist strategies only as selectable tested baselines, off by default

decision_rules.name: Keep hit logs whole
decision_rules.condition: a hit or judgment is recorded
decision_rules.outcome: persist it as a real event and never rotate or archive away the log, whatever its size

decision_rules.name: Keep bookkeeping out of the meaning pool
decision_rules.condition: a tag is a marker (kind, agent, span, tool, node, flag, outcome, scope)
decision_rules.outcome: namespace it so it never competes with meaning keywords
